defendant: BROAD & MARKET INVESTMENTS, LLC; MOHAMMED EASMAEL
description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CAPE MAY COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000219
DOCKET NO. F-89-26
PLAINTIFF – FULTON BANK, N.A.
DEFENDANTS- BROAD & MARKET INVESTMENTS, LLC; MOHAMMED EASMAEL
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 2nd DAY OF September 2026
At 1:00 o'clock in the afternoon at the old Courthouse building located at 9 N Main Street (Route 9), in Cape May Court House, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the CITY OF WILDWOOD of Wildwood, County of Cape May and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: 2910 Boardwalk, Wildwood (Commercial Property) LOT 15, BLOCK 229 APPROX. DIMENSIONS: 18 X 94, NEAREST CROSS STREET: OCEAN AVENUE, AND
Being Known as: 2910 Beach, Wildwood (Vacant Lot) LOT 4.01, BLOCK 274 APPROX. DIMENSIONS: 18.69 X 476, NEAREST CROSS STREET: OCEAN AVENUE
BOTH TO BE SOLD AS ONE
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
2910 BOARDWALK Wildwood, NJ 08260 and
2910 Beach, Wildwood, NJ 08260
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Cape May County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: Lot 15, Block 229 Taxes (Commercial Property)- at time of inquiry- 1st quarter 2026 taxes open in the amount of $4,703.22 and 2nd quarter taxes open in the base amount of $4,549.94 + interest through payoff.
Water- at the time of inquiry 1st and 2nd quarter 2026 open in the amount of $383.45 + interest through payoff
Sewer- at the time of inquiry delinquent charges past due for 4/1/26 in the amount of $149.62 + interest through payoff; current charge due 6/1/26 open in the amount of $147.74 *Also subject to subsequent taxes, water and sewer plus interest through date of payoff
(Vacant Lot): Lot 4.01, Block 274 Taxes- at time of inquiry- taxes are paid to date
Tax Sale Cert No. 23-00105 sold to Garden State Investment on 12/19/23 in the base amount of $530.66 + subsequent payments made in the amount of $1,365.36 + any additional subsequent charges paid thereafter, plus interest/fees/penalties through redemption; *Also subject to subsequent taxes, water and sewer plus interest through date of payoff.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Cape May County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $546,847.42 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Robert A. Nolan, SHERIFF
DATED: June 4, 2026
Romano Garubo & Argentieri, LLC
52 Newton Avenue, P.O. Box 456
Woodbury, NJ 08096. 856-384-1515
